title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.124.2 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions before 15.124.2 and 16.x before 16.50.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in the Accounts module. This flaw allows authenticated Accounts Users to modify bank clearance dates on payment documents belonging to other companies or already submitted documents, bypassing user permission checks. This compromises the integrity of bank reconciliation data.
